description: This file defines the OrderByItem class, which implements a comparator for sorting GenericEntity objects based on specified ordering conditions, such as ascending or descending, and handling nulls first or last. It includes methods for parsing order expressions, generating SQL order strings, and comparing entity instances.

classes.name: OrderByItem
classes.description: Represents an ordering condition for sorting GenericEntity objects, with support for direction (ascending/descending), nulls placement (first/last), and parsing string expressions to create order conditions.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the EntityConditionValue used for ordering.

methods.name: getDescending
methods.description: Indicates whether the order is descending.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an object into an OrderByItem instance, supporting strings, EntityConditionValues, or other OrderByItems.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a string expression into an OrderByItem, handling nulls, direction, and case sensitivity.

methods.name: checkOrderBy
methods.description: Validates that the order by value applies to the given model entity.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two GenericEntity objects based on the order condition.

methods.name: makeOrderByString
methods.description: Generates an SQL order by clause string based on the order condition.

methods.name: makeOrderByString
methods.description: Appends the SQL order by clause string to a StringBuilder.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code for the order by item.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the order by condition.
